OceanaGold (OGC) said President and CEO Gerard Bond plans to retire in April 2027 after five years leading the company, according to the
Bond will remain as a special advisor to the Board and incoming CEO for six months after his departure to support the transition.
The company has appointed Spencer Stuart to assist with the search for his successor, evaluating both internal and external candidates.
The company said it remains on track to deliver its 2026 production guidance and advance its growth pipeline.

title: OceanaGold CEO Gerard Bond to step down in April 2027
